subject.title: fix(chat): preserve explicit current-source sends in Control UI history

question: Should `sourceReplyRoute: "current-source"` be the canonical internal proof that an explicit send belongs in the active session's Control UI history?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but the marker couples the outbound owner to agent and gateway history consumers, so its permanence and ownership require an explicit maintainer choice.

options.title: Adopt the marker invariant
options.body: Keep the structured marker as the canonical prepared route fact and require history consumers to trust only owner-produced metadata.

options.title: Use delivery mirrors only
options.body: Remove the new marker and route explicit current-source visibility through the existing authoritative transcript delivery-mirror mechanism.

options.title: Pause for broader consolidation
options.body: Defer this slice until the wider channel-to-Control-UI transcript ownership work is designed with the remaining related issues.

recommendation.title: Adopt the marker invariant
recommendation.body: Keep the structured marker as the canonical prepared route fact and require history consumers to trust only owner-produced metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to adjacent source-reply, gateway, and transcript ownership decisions.
